text:
maria_csm: Hey team — onboarding for AcmeHealth. They've installed the JS SDK but are seeing intermittent 401s after a key rotation and spiky 429s during their load test. Can someone triage? They say token is in header, app v0.9.1.

sam_devx: Can you paste the SDK init snippet + the raw 401 body? Also: are they rotating keys programmatically or manually?

maria_csm: Snippet: ```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY,
  baseUrl: 'https://api.redwood.ai',
  timeout: 20000,
  retries: 2
});
```
401 body they reported: `{"error":"Unauthorized","code":401}` — started right after they ran a key-rotate job.

raj_engineer: That 401 looks like old key still being used by some pods. If rotation is rolling, some processes will still hold the old key in memory. Are they restarting pods after updating the k8s secret?

maria_csm: They update the k8s secret and do a rolling restart (no full restart). They didn't restart all pods simultaneously.

raj_engineer: That explains it — some pods still have cached env var. Options: do a full restart or we can enable short grace period where we accept previous key for 5m to avoid 401s during rotation. I'll check with security.

jen_support: On the 429s side: looks like the load test is a burst from many clients. Recommend SDK-level smoothing: `client.setRateLimit({ maxQPS: 50, burst: 10 })` and we can bump their account burst quota temporarily. @maria_csm want me to enable a temporary increase? :hourglass_flowing_sand:␤

maria_csm: please enable for 24h, they need to finish e2e tests today :pray: 

jen_support: Done — temporary burst quota increased to 3x for 24h. Monitor telemetry at https://console.redwood.ai/customers/acmehealth/telemetry :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deployment acme-service v1.3.7 rolled out by acme-ci at 1723456830

sam_devx: Also double-check they're sending `Authorization: 'Bearer <KEY>'` header (not `?api_key=`). Example snippet for docs: `headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` }`. Added link to docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/sdk#auth

maria_csm: I'll ask Acme to restart all pods and re-run the load test. Updating the ticket now. Thanks all! :tada: 

raj_engineer: Follow-up action: I'll add an alert to detect >1% 401s in a 5m window after key rotation. Can you paste sample failing logs into the ticket?

maria_csm: Adding logs and request traces to CS-1202: https://redwoodsupport.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1202 

sam_devx: lgtm

jen_support: Ping me if 429s continue after the quota bump and smoothing changes — we can look at temporary routing/fallback to a cheaper model to absorb load.

maria_csm: Will do, appreciate the quick help!
